Generate prefix execution names with legacy recovery

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-25
  description: |-
    Newly planned execution branches and worktrees now use uppercase Issue-prefix components while persisted Workspace-key names stay exact.
    
    Planning generates DAM-style prefix names, discovers an existing prefix ref first, and falls back to the historical key-form ref without renaming or duplicating Git refs. Database checks accept both historical key components and new uppercase prefix components, and the forward migration does not rewrite existing environment rows.
